decoded.target: OLS exposures to the top 5 unit-variance principal components of standardized prior factor residuals of firms outside the cohort
decoded.control: rank-5 coordinates of prior residual covariance (in-panel)
decoded.decoder: standardized ridge, 5-fold out of fold across firms; held-out states and predictions clipped to the training fold's range

kernels.median: exp(-d/m), m = median positive off-diagonal distance
kernels.matched: exp(-d/h), h matches that year's joint Fernandez effective neighbours

innovations.diagonal: one variance per firm and year, same rule for every network
innovations.correlation: diagonal-arm correlation with prior raw sample variances

lambda: one per network, kernel and innovation arm, fitted on calibration years
